name: the charset set is reported per server
description: GET /api/db/charset-info reports the charset and collation set each node supports, choosing utf8mb4 when the server has it and falling back to the binary/utf8 pair otherwise — the same choice PhabricatorStorageManagementAPI makes, so Phorge's schema comparison sees the inputs it expects. The seeded node has utf8mb4, so it reports the utf8mb4 set keyed by its refKey.
